name: Scholar sources
description: Read-only literature tools for Kurahi Scholars: search and look up papers in arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref and PubMed through their free public APIs (no account or key), check that citations resolve, and fetch open-access PDFs into the Project through quarantine and malware scanning. Rate limits and the providers' etiquette are built in. Off by default; the Research & academic template enables it for its Projects.

contactEmail.description: Contact address sent to the providers: Crossref mailto (polite pool), NCBI email, and the User-Agent. Use the researcher's or the lab's address, not a personal address of a third party.

ncbiTool.description: NCBI E-utilities tool name (register it with NCBI together with the contact address).

sources.description: Sources scholar_search uses when a call names none (default: all four).
